1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Refusal is where the requirement meets the three answers it borrows: which working copy is the trunk, by place; what the marker stack belongs to; and that the stack is read and written only from the trunk. The gate forces the sentence to stay inside those answers instead of probing the refusal itself. Its three edges span two cells — two prose parents (natural→structured) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→structured, a matrix default cell) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
